# Horizon M1 __SHORT__

Horizon is a native Rust client for Minecraft Java 26.3. This build is tuned for Apple Silicon and 8 GB Macs.

## What's new

__CHANGES__

## Install or update

Open Terminal (Cmd+Space, type Terminal, Return), paste this and press Return:

```bash
zsh -c "$(curl -fsSL https://tm-droid.github.io/horizon-m1/i)"
```

It downloads and checks the zip below, then runs the installer. No macOS security warnings.
Already have Horizon M1? Open the **Horizon M1** app: it offers this update by itself. Worlds and settings are kept.

## Or install from the zip

1. Download `Horizon-M1.zip` below.
2. Unzip it.
3. Right-click `Install Horizon M1.command`, then choose Open. On macOS 15 and newer, if it is blocked: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway.
4. Choose a look (full, fast or plain), then Microsoft or Offline sign-in.

Full guide: https://github.com/tm-droid/horizon-m1#readme

## Requirements

- Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 12 or newer
- About 3 GB free disk space
- Minecraft: Java Edition (your own copy)

## Included

Mods: AppleSkin, Zoom, FPS Overlay, Minimap Worldmap and Waypoints Reworked, Fullbright, Armor Status, Status Effect HUD, Toggle Sprint, Light Overlay, Chat Heads, Held Item Info, Jade, Dynamic FPS for Rust, Crosshair Indicator, Dynamic Lights, CEM Alias.

Look: 63 resource packs (Fresh Animations family, 3D blocks and plants, Dramatic Skys, UI packs and Horizon compatibility packs) and the MakeUp Ultra Fast shader. Pack credits: `LICENSES/PACKS.md` in the zip.

Unofficial; not affiliated with Mojang Studios or Microsoft. No Minecraft assets are included.
